notes: Every protocol arm except FRONTIER (needs explicit API-spend approval) and ORACLE (derived by `logit-fusion summarize` from the A, B, C member reports).
Member names in specs (A, B, C, BIG) bind to GGUF paths through the modelSet: q8 = A-q8,B-q8,C-q8,BIG-q4; q4 = A-q4,B-q4,C-q4,BIG-q4; big-q8 = BIG-q8 (keys in models.json).
Pilot (S2) runs before S3 tuning: host-run rewrites `:tuned` to `:uniform`, keeps tie-break member B, runs vote-conf uncalibrated, and records the rewrite as `pilotSubstitution`.

`${SC_K}` is resolved by host-run from env SC_K (default 2). The default is a placeholder [believed]; the protocol sets k so SC-k decode compute is within +/-10% of F-tuned as measured, so k must be re-set from pilot core-seconds before S4.

dependsOn lists arm labels whose reports (same dataset, same run mode) are passed as --member-reports; they are reused, never regenerated, so vote/rerank compute = dependency compute + aggregation/scoring compute.

arms.label: A
arms.notes: Per-component baseline.

arms.label: B
arms.notes: Per-component baseline; pilot tie-break member.

arms.label: C
arms.notes: Per-component baseline; largest member (SC-k source).

arms.label: BIG
arms.notes: Memory-matched control, Qwen3 8B Q4_K_M. Also serves as BIG-Q4 for H6 (same file).

arms.label: A-think
arms.notes: Thinking-mode member; feeds VOTE-think/-consist/-conf and calibration.

arms.label: B-think
arms.notes: Thinking-mode member.

arms.label: C-think
arms.notes: Thinking-mode member.

arms.label: BIG-think
arms.notes: Thinking-mode memory-matched control.

arms.label: AB
arms.notes: Leave-one-out pair (H5). Fused arms run non-thinking only.

arms.label: AC
arms.notes: Leave-one-out pair (H5).

arms.label: BC
arms.notes: Leave-one-out pair (H5).

arms.label: F-uniform
arms.notes: Fusion with no tuning.

arms.label: F-tuned
arms.notes: Primary treatment. In the pilot this is identical to F-uniform by substitution; the stop rule is evaluated on that stand-in and the report must say so.

arms.label: F-mix
arms.notes: Combination-rule comparison.

arms.label: F-article
arms.notes: Raw-logit sum as published in the article; weights fixed by the protocol, never tuned.

arms.label: VOTE
arms.notes: Answer-level majority. Full runs: tie-break member must equal the dev-split best member recorded in the frozen JSON; B is the pilot default. Tie-break is the development-split best member from frozen.json (spec :best); the S2 pilot runs with --pilot true, which substitutes member B and records it.

arms.label: VOTE-think
arms.notes: Plain-vote baseline for H7. Tie-break is the development-split best member from frozen.json (spec :best); the S2 pilot runs with --pilot true, which substitutes member B and records it.

arms.label: VOTE-consist
arms.notes: Drops votes whose reasoning answer differs from the stated answer; keeps all if all dropped. Tie-break is the development-split best member from frozen.json (spec :best); the S2 pilot runs with --pilot true, which substitutes member B and records it.

arms.label: VOTE-conf
arms.notes: Votes weighted by calibrated answer-token confidence (G7). Pilot runs uncalibrated (temperature 1 per member) by substitution. Tie-break is the development-split best member from frozen.json (spec :best); the S2 pilot runs with --pilot true, which substitutes member B and records it.

arms.label: RERANK
arms.notes: H8: fusion used for verification. Compute = dependency generation + prefill-only scoring, reported separately.

arms.label: RERANK-think
arms.notes: The protocol runs RERANK in both thinking modes.

arms.label: SC-k
arms.notes: Compute-matched control; k samples of C at T=0.7, seeds seed..seed+k-1, prompt KV reused. k must be re-set from pilot-measured compute (H3 requires +/-10%).

arms.label: SC-k-think
arms.notes: Thinking-mode SC-k.

arms.label: F-tuned-Q4
arms.notes: H6. A-q4 and B-q4 are proposed-substitute pins (no official Q4_K_M for 0.6B/1.7B); host-run refuses them unless ALLOW_PROPOSED_PINS=1. Uses the Q8-tuned weights (protocol tunes once).

arms.label: BIG-Q4
arms.notes: H6. Same GGUF (BIG-q4) and same configuration as BIG; host-run may reuse the BIG report. Kept as a label so the H6 comparison names both sides.

arms.label: BIG-Q8
arms.notes: Required by the H6 decision rule (BIG-Q8 - BIG-Q4). Also the threat-list 'second BIG at Q8_0'. 8.7 GB file; needs a host with enough RAM.
